meta.name: game-design-review
meta.description: Invoke when the user wants feedback on a game design document, GDD review, design evaluation, or consistency check on an existing design. Triggers on: "review my GDD", "design feedback", "evaluate design", "design document review", "GDD critique". Do NOT invoke for brainstorming new ideas (use game-brainstorm) or balance tuning (use game-balance-check). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取游戏设计文档的专业反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在撰写或修改游戏设计文档，需要外部视角的评估。
copy.tagline_en: Get professional feedback on your game design document.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing or revising a game design document and need an external evaluation.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的游戏设计文档，检查核心机制是否与设计支柱一致、玩家心理是否被考虑、范围是否可行，并输出一份带严重等级和修改建议的评审报告。
howto.when: 当你要求评审游戏设计文档（GDD），例如说“review my GDD”、“design feedback”、“evaluate design”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我评审我的游戏设计文档，看看核心机制是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会读取文档并生成一份完整的评审报告。

say.text: 我们的玩法测试出了问题，帮我检查设计文档中的MDA一致性。
say.note: Claude 会重点分析机制与目标美学的匹配度。

say.text: 我觉得项目范围太大了，帮我评估一下可行性。
say.note: Claude 会统计系统数量、估算内容量并与团队能力对比。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your game design document, checks if core mechanics align with design pillars, evaluates player psychology and scope feasibility, and outputs a review report with severity ratings and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a GDD review, design feedback, design evaluation, or consistency check, e.g., "review my GDD", "design feedback", "evaluate design".

say_en.text: Review my GDD for internal consistency.
say_en.note: Claude reads the document and produces a full review report.

say_en.text: Our playtest went badly. Check MDA consistency in the design.
I think our scope is too big. Assess feasibility.
say_en.note: Claude counts systems, estimates content, and compares with team capacity.
